question: Who was appointed as the Governor of Manipur in December 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anusuiya Uikey**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Anusuiya Uikey** was appointed as the **Governor of Manipur** in **December 2024**. 
• She previously served as the Governor of **Chhattisgarh**, showcasing her extensive administrative experience. 
• Her appointment as Governor of Manipur highlights the Government of India's focus on appointing experienced leaders to key gubernatorial roles in northeastern states. 
• Manipur, being a state of strategic importance in the northeast, benefits from her leadership and administrative capabilities. 
• Governors in India are appointed by the **President of India under Article 155 of the Constitution**, and they serve as the constitutional head of their respective states. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Role of Governors in India:** 
• The Governor is the **constitutional head of the state**, acting on the advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the Chief Minister. 
• They have the power to reserve certain bills for the consideration of the President under **Article 200**. 
• The Governor also plays a critical role in ensuring the state’s administration is conducted per the provisions of the Constitution. 
• **Appointment of Governors:** 
• Governors are appointed by the **President of India** for a term of **five years**, but they serve at the pleasure of the President. 
• They can be transferred between states and may also be reappointed for a second term. 
• **Manipur - Strategic Importance:** 
• Manipur is a northeastern state with significant geographical and cultural importance, sharing borders with Myanmar. 
• The state plays a vital role in India's **Act East Policy**, enhancing trade and connectivity with Southeast Asia. 
• It is known for its diverse cultural heritage, including traditional dances like **Raas Leela** and sports such as **Polo**, which originated here. 
• **Key Functions of the Governor:** 
• Appointing the Chief Minister and other ministers. 
• Summoning, proroguing, and dissolving the state legislature. 
• Granting pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment under **Article 161**. 
• Ensuring the constitutional machinery of the state is upheld, particularly under **Article 356** in case of a constitutional crisis.
